title: 第二十八章 惊艳
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
现身之人，正是汪天韵。

    待仙灵剑宗弟子清剿完妖兽后，便已尽数撤走。

    唯独汪天韵留在原处，与萧京溪、白洁一般，暗中潜伏，准备伏击。

    没曾想，还真有三个不知死活的家伙，径直来到了此地。

    见是汪天韵，那三道黑影俱是一怔，旋即心知不妙。

    “仙灵剑宗真传?你怎会在此?还有你方才说‘小剑仙’......“

    为首的黑影眉头紧锁。

    人的名，树的影。

    “仙灵剑宗小剑仙”这个名号，可绝非易与之辈。“不错。你们的图谋，她仅听描述便已全然识破，短短工夫便将你们三个逮个正着。呵。”

    汪天韵语带嘲讽，亦不乏感慨。

    他此行对萧京溪确实有了不小的改观，仿佛初次真正认识了这位一直令他倾慕的师妹。

    原来这位小剑仙，竟是这般聪慧过人、果决非凡的人物么?

    他方才那句“只可惜你们撞上了小剑仙”，确是发自肺腑。

    若非这位师妹一眼洞穿，这三个家伙说不定还真能继续兴风作浪一阵子。

    只是......

    了解愈深的同时，汪天韵觉得......

    自己这份情愫，或许还需再斟酌一番。总觉着，日后若真与这位师妹结为道侣，怕是万事皆难瞒她，倘若自己行差踏错，极可能被她算计布局，活活玩死......

    念及此，汪天韵不由得打了个寒噤。

    有点发怵，不太确定，容后再思量。

    那三道黑影此刻已知彻底暴露，便也不再伪装。

    褪去身上黑衣，三人现出身形。

    样貌正是城主府内的城主、管家与仆从。

    只是那一张张面孔僵硬如死，毫无表情，显得极不协调。

    “小子，奉劝你一句。眼下你一无线索实证，二来修为不足，真动起手不过是自寻死路。我等杀了你，亦可从容脱身，难以追查。”

    说到此处，为首的黑影目光一转。

    “不如你就此退去，我等亦会离开此地，岂不两全其美?”

    话音方落，其身上元婴期的威压轰然爆发。

    汪天韵尚未回应，便听得一声剑吟骤起。
content_en:
The person who showed up was none other than Wang Tianyun.

    After the disciples of the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect had finished wiping out the demonic beasts, they had all left.

    Only Wang Tianyun stayed where he was, lurking secretly like Xiao Jingxi and Bai Jie, preparing for an ambush.

    I never thought that three guys who didn't know whether to live or die came straight to this place.

    Seeing that it was Wang Tianyun, the three black shadows were startled, and they immediately knew something was wrong.

    "The true biography of the Immortal Spirit Sword Sect? Why are you here? And you just said 'Little Sword Immortal'..."

    The leading shadow frowned.

    A person's name, the shadow of a tree.

    The name "Xianling Sword Sect's Little Sword Immortal" is by no means easy for this generation. "That's right. She was able to see through your plan just by hearing the description, and she caught the three of you in a short time. Ha."

    Wang Tianyun's words were sarcastic, but also full of emotion.

    During this trip, he really had a great impression of Xiao Jingxi, as if he had truly gotten to know this junior sister he had always admired for the first time.

    Did it turn out that this little swordsman was such an intelligent and decisive person?

    What he just said, "It's a pity that you bumped into the little sword fairy" was indeed from the bottom of his heart.

    If this junior sister hadn't seen through at a glance, these three guys might have been able to continue making trouble for a while.

    Just...

    As the understanding deepened, Wang Tianyun felt...

    Perhaps I need to reconsider my feelings. I always feel that if I really become a Taoist companion with this junior sister in the future, I am afraid that it will be difficult to hide everything from her. If I make a mistake, I will most likely be plotted by her and played to death...

    Thinking of this, Wang Tianyun couldn't help but shudder.

    I'm a little scared, not sure, I'll think about it later.

    Now that the three black shadows were completely exposed, they stopped pretending.

    After taking off their black clothes, the three of them appeared.

    They looked exactly like the city lord, steward and servants in the city lord's mansion.

    It's just that the faces were as stiff as death, expressionless, and seemed extremely uncoordinated.

    "Boy, I'd like to advise you. Right now, you have no clues to prove it, and secondly, your cultivation is not enough. If you really take action, you're just asking for your own death. If we kill you, you can escape easily and it will be difficult to trace."

    Speaking of this, the leader of the black shadow turned his eyes.

    "Why don't you just retreat and we will leave this place too? Wouldn't it be the best of both worlds?"

    As soon as he finished speaking, the pressure of the Nascent Soul Stage on his body exploded.

    Before Wang Tianyun responded, he heard a sword roar.
